Watch the future of baseball today. Stream the best Minor League Baseball games featuring top prospects and MLB stars on rehab assignments. See tomorrow's superstars before they reach the big leagues, on the MiLB Channel.

Shows: Minor League Baseball, Leo De Vries (MLB No. 4 Prospect) With a Three-Hit Game, Leo De Vries (MLB No. 4 Prospect) With a Three Hit, Three-RBI Game, A's Top Two Prospects (Leo De Vries and Jaime Arnold) Shine, Jaime Arnold (A's #2 Prospect) Tosses Seven Shutout Innings
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
